definitions.gloss: close friend, best friend, intimate friend
definitions.explanation: A friend with whom one has a very close and trusting relationship.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{親友|しんゆう}だ。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}からの{親友|しんゆう}に{久|ひさ}しぶりに{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I met up with a close friend from childhood after a long time.

examples.japanese: {親友|しんゆう}には{何|なん}でも{話|はな}せる。
examples.english: I can talk about anything with my best friend.

notes:
{親友|しんゆう} implies a deeper level of friendship than {友達|ともだち}.

COMPARISON:
- {親友|しんゆう}: close/best friend (intimate relationship)
- {友達|ともだち}: friend (general)
- {友人|ゆうじん}: friend (more formal)
- {知|し}り{合|あ}い: acquaintance

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {親友|しんゆう}になる (to become close friends)
- {一生|いっしょう}の{親友|しんゆう} (lifelong friend)
- {無二|むに}の{親友|しんゆう} (one and only best friend)
